one_month_reasoning: No earnings in the window: Q3 FY27 results are due around early December 2026. Scheduled or expected items before 2026-10-30: (1) final settlement of the $25B ASR, expected in October 2026, which mechanically cuts the share count further but is already known and priced; (2) the Contentful and Fin acquisitions, expected to close 'in the coming weeks' during Q3, also known; (3) the Dreamforce/Investor Day (Sept 16) news flow (Claudeforce, the $63B+ FY30 target) is already out. The stock rose about 20% after Q2 on Aug 26, then pulled back from about $242 (Sept 10) to $231, so there is no clear drift signal to trade. Macro prints (CPI, FOMC) and software-sector swings on AI-disruption headlines are the main drivers. I use a nearly symmetric lognormal centred just under spot, with a 12.5% monthly sigma, a bit below 47%/3.5 = 13.4% because no earnings fall in the window.

fair_value.method: Blend of P/E on FY29 (NTM as of Sept 2027) core non-GAAP EPS of ~$18.3 at 14x = $256, and SBC-adjusted FCF per share of ~$16.5 at 15x = $248; weights 50/50, giving ~$252.

bear.story: Agentforce stays small (ARR ~$1.5B, a few % of revenue) while AI agents start to compress seats in Sales and Service Cloud; organic growth slides to ~7-8% once Informatica laps; the market treats CRM as a leveraged ex-growth app at ~11-12x core EPS of ~$15. The 1H26 lows ($146) show how far the 'SaaSpocalypse' narrative can push the multiple.

base.story: 11-12% revenue growth (cRPO +14%), a stable ~34-35% non-GAAP margin, and a ~14% lower share count after the ASR lift core EPS to ~$18 NTM; the multiple holds near 14x.

bull.story: Agentforce and Data 360 ARR (~$3.9B, +210%) keep compounding, Claudeforce/AIforce turn the Anthropic tie-up into consumption revenue, seat counts keep growing, and the market re-rates CRM toward 17-18x on ~$18.5 EPS; the Anthropic stake adds optional value.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$165 (about 11x NTM core EPS and roughly the lower end of the post-SaaSpocalypse range) the price would imply that core seat revenue is shrinking or that the cRPO/FCF trajectory has broken (e.g. FY28 guide below 8% growth or FCF falling), not ordinary volatility. At that level the ASR (average ~$182) would also be underwater, and on ~$39B of debt the balance-sheet argument would weaken.

reasoning: Basic facts come from Salesforce's Q2 FY27 8-K: revenue +11% with ~4pts from Informatica, cRPO +14%, FY27 non-GAAP EPS guide $16.69 including $2.98 of Anthropic-driven investment gains, FCF guide +4-5% on FY26's $14.4B, and a $25B ASR with ~$39B of debt. Core EPS is about $13.7 on 838M shares, or about $14.4 on post-ASR shares, so the stock at $231 trades at ~15x NTM core EPS. Lane evidence: newsletters (Trades & Gains, Aug 25) warn that Agentforce is only ~2.6-3% of revenue and that the 'Agentforce Sales' segment is largely a relabel, and point to sandbagged guidance with a 17% average beat. Summit Stocks (Sept 2) reports near-record-low attrition, Slack premium upgrades tripled, and 1M Slackbot users, and puts EV/FCF at 21x with a 'buy' band of $200-300. Job and alt data (SalesforceBen): headcount +9% despite layoffs, 1,000+ Agentforce sellers hired, and AE counts up 20%+, which point to investment rather than retrenchment. Admin and user review aggregators show mixed Agentforce sentiment: cost, pricing predictability and ROI are the complaints, which caps the bull case. No Polymarket or Kalshi market on CRM was found. X/Twitter was not searched directly; no claim here depends on it. Valuation: 14x FY29 core EPS of ~$18.3 = $256, and 15x SBC-adjusted FCF per share of ~$16.5 = $248, for a fair value of ~$252, about 9% above spot, mostly from EPS growth and the share-count cut rather than re-rating. The ladder is a 25/50/25 mixture of lognormals centred at $170 / $248 / $325 (sigmas 30/22/22%). That gives a median of ~$245 and effective dispersion of ~35-40%, below the 47% realized vol, which was inflated by the 1H26 SaaSpocalypse crash and the post-earnings spike. Research was limited to ~12 queries.
